Terms of use

Last updated November 25, 2026.

ShelterDayOut is a program of Charity Good (charitygood.org) ("Charity Good", "we", "us"). By using ShelterDayOut (the "site") you agree to these terms.

A directory, not a service provider

ShelterDayOut is an information directory. We list programs run by independent animal shelters and rescues. We are not affiliated with them unless a listing says so, and we don't run outings, sleepovers, visits or adoptions. Each shelter decides who may participate and sets its own rules, fees, agreements and waivers, which govern your outing.

Information may change

We check listings regularly, but program details change and may be wrong or out of date. Always confirm details with the shelter. The site is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind.

Outing requests

You can send a shelter an outing request through the site. We email your request to the shelter's public contact address and, where it has one, its program address. Sending a request doesn't guarantee an outing. The shelter alone decides whether to approve it. We aren't a party to any arrangement between you and a shelter.

Your responsibility

Animals can be unpredictable. You're responsible for following the shelter's instructions and for your own conduct and safety during any outing. To the fullest extent the law allows, ShelterDayOut isn't liable for any injury, loss, damage or dispute arising from an outing, visit, request or your use of the site.

Acceptable use

Don't submit false information, impersonate a shelter, spam shelters through request forms, or copy the site's content in bulk by automated means.

Shelters

Shelters may ask us to correct or remove their listing at any time through the For shelters page.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms; the date above shows the latest version. Questions: hello@shelterdayout.com.
